capabilities: Run focus and break sessions with animated themes and no visible countdown
Link sessions to tasks from the Tasks plugin and add per-task pomodoro counts
Write one Markdown log file per day with Dataview-readable fields and a daily focus goal
Export sessions to CSV or JSON Lines and paste ready-made Dataview tables
Play lofi music from pasted YouTube links in the timer panel
extras: The README marks the release as beta, discloses that parts of the code were developed with AI assistance, and details the optional YouTube music's network use and privacy implications.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus timer, and timers that show a countdown can be distracting during focused work.

relations.evidence: Tasks: the task picker reads its format.
Dataview: reads the daily log; the Log tables buttons give code for it.

summary: Pomodoro timer with day-to-night visual themes that links sessions to Tasks-plugin tasks and writes Dataview-readable daily logs.
